focus.name: interaction-spawn-type13-type14-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the selector-0x28 Type-0x13 and selector-0x13 Type-0x14 interaction creators to stable creation identities while retaining their historical selector-qualified names.

handlers.name: InteractionSpawn_CreateType13Interaction_28
handlers.post_spawn: submit palette source 0x00129152 and optionally queue interaction audio command 0x32

contracts: Selector 0x28 creates the Type-0x13 interaction actor only when the interaction gate is clear and PLAYER_WORLD_Y lies in the recorded contact window.
The Type-0x13 creator submits its palette source after allocation and conditionally queues interaction audio command 0x32.
Selector 0x13 creates the Type-0x14 interaction actor from its dedicated template through LevelObjectSpawnEntry.
The Type-0x13 and Type-0x14 templates enter their separately bounded AnimationVM roots at 0x00124658 and 0x00124766.
evidence: Exact handler bodies and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
Established Type-0x13 and Type-0x14 template and AnimationVM records
limitations: The names identify exact runtime types and interaction creation paths, not user-facing scene roles.
The Type-0x14 root's downstream Type-0x84 presentation-child behavior remains a separate animation-service identity.
